{"consolidated_memory":"## Spurious 429 Rate Limiter Issues - Three Separate Occasions

All three incidents occurred in **api/gateway/rate_limit.go** on the API gateway side. All share the same common signal: throttle counters far above the configured ceiling. All can be reproduced by replaying the saved burst fixture. The test file is api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go. Same corner of code throughout; context carried over between incidents.

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-03] Clock Skew Issue
- **Trigger:** Clock skew between two hosts, affecting users sitting in negative UTC offset zones
- **Root cause:** Clock skew between the two hosts
- **Fix:** Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- **PR #3478, branch fix/spurious-429-1**
- **Performance result:** Memory settled at 266 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

### Occasion 2: [2026-04-21] Off-by-One Slice Bound Issue
- **Trigger:** First request after a cold start
- **Root cause:** Off-by-one in the slice bound
- **Fix:** Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR #8318, branch fix/spurious-429-2**
- **Performance result:** Job finished in 67 minutes instead of 5 hours

### Occasion 3: [2026-06-21] Missing Unicode Normalisation Issue
- **Trigger:** Only on the staging read replica
- **Root cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR #9063, branch fix/spurious-429-3**
- **Performance result:** Cold start dropped 72 percent, to 966 ms"}
